name: Hearty Amani Cornucopia
tooltip:
Hearty Amani Cornucopia
Item Level 90
Binds to Warband
Use: Place a Hearty Amani Cornucopia for all players to enjoy!

Restores 7% of your maximum health and mana every second over 20 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

Hearty Well Fed
If you spend at least 10 seconds eating, you will become Hearty Well Fed gaining (98 * 1.1) Stamina and (65 * 1.1) of your highest secondary stat for 1 hour.

This aura persists through death.
Requires Level 90
Max Stack: 1000
Sell Price: 33 50
